craft_notes: Sthāyin: twin spells, two directions. Rows: mantras then order. Read aloud: chanted names.

lines: hrīṃ na pha hrīṃ, hrīṃ ā kṣa hrīṃ — thus;
by these twain, voicing Might and Might's lord,
with each alone: first Might, then the Mighty —
in release from foot-tip to crown's end;
l4.sanskrit_cite: hrīṃ na pha hrīṃ hrīṃ ā kṣa hrīṃ ity ābhyāṃ śaktiśaktimadvācakābhyāṃ mālinīśabdarāśimantrābhyām ekenaiva ādau śaktiḥ tataḥ śaktimān iti muktau pādāgrāc chiro'ntam bhuktau tu sarvo viparyayaḥ
